create_inference_batcher: create an InferenceBatcher instance with a predict_unit to batch incoming inference requests
use_inference_batcher_context_manager: use InferenceBatcher as a context manager to auto shutdown the executor on exit
get_batch_predict_unit: get the BatchServerPredictUnit from an InferenceBatcher via the batch_predict_unit cached property
shutdown_inference_batcher: call shutdown on an InferenceBatcher to stop the executor and clean up resources
get_concurrency_backend: get a ThreadPoolExecutor concurrency backend for running ASE calculations concurrently
